summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. (BHRB) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its merger with LINKBANCORP, Inc. (LNKB) effective May 1, 2026. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated December 18, 2025, each LNKB share was converted into 0.1350 BHRB shares, with cash for fractional shares. Total consideration was ~5.1 million BHRB shares. LNKB's equity awards vested fully. The merger was structured as a stock-for-stock transaction, with LNKB merging into BHRB, and LINKBANK merging into BHRB's bank subsidiary. The S-4 registration statement was declared effective January 30, 2026. Watch for post-merger integration and potential cost synergies; risk-arb focuses on BHRB share price stability relative to the exchange ratio.
